description: HTML to Markdown converter — Convert an HTML snippet or document to clean GitHub-flavored Markdown offline (for LLM context, docs, notes). html= URL-encoded HTML up to 100,000 characters. Handles headings, paragraphs, bold/italic/strikethrough, inline code and fenced code blocks with language (class language-x), nested ordered/unordered lists and task lists, blockquotes, links and images, GFM tables (caption, colspan, pipes escaped), definition lists, hr/br, HTML entities; drops script/style/svg/iframe, form controls and javascript: links. Options: base= absolute URL to resolve relative links and images, main=true keeps only <main>/<article> (strips nav/footer chrome), links=inline|reference|text, images=false, escape=false (no Markdown escaping). Returns markdown, page title, word/char counts and element stats. For a live page by URL use /v1/web/extract. Price: $0.002 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: text_html_to_markdown
